column2: I wonder how much I'd be worth in this city...
They're strong! This isn't what we agreed to!!
Th-they're pretty good!
This job doesn't pay nearly enough!
Whoa there—I don't remember selling my life!
The more we take down, the more money we get...
Don't you run away on me!
Getting paid to kill $$奴隷$$? $$この世$$ is a bed of roses!
Don't underestimate me!
I'm paid more than those small-time punks!
Heh heh! Kill these guys and I'll be rich!
What's with these guys? They're pretty good.
Whoa, careful there.
Not bad, you hired guns!
Then, a flashy spell should do it...
Or so I would say, but without $$死体$$...
I cannot cast a spell, after all...
You are not so willing to sell even your lives, are you?!
Our lives... are not merchandise!!
(The $$大邪神$$'s power... could it really be...)
(stronger than money?)
You can do it, Sir Knight!
You dare lay your filthy hands on me...?! You have some nerve!
Cracka-cracka-KABOOOM!! Zappy-zappy-ZWIIING!!
Smacka-smacka-KABOOOM!!
If you make me get serious... you're going to regret it!
Eeeek! Don't come any closer!!
